subject: Workplace Skills
title: Status Updates That Build Trust
description: Learn Status Updates That Build Trust in one minute.

hook.text: A manager said: 'The people I trust most are the ones I never have to chase for updates.' Information builds trust.

buildup.text: Proactive updates reduce your boss's anxiety. When they don't have to ask, they assume you're in control.

discovery.text: The right frequency depends on your boss. Weekly works for most. During crises, daily is expected.

twist.text: Over-updating is as bad as under-updating. Too many messages signal anxiety and clog their inbox with noise.

climax.text: Agree on update cadence explicitly. 'I will send a weekly Friday email. Let me know if you want more or less.'

punchline.text: Update before they ask. Trust compounds silently.

quiz.question: What is the biggest benefit of proactive status updates?
options: They create a paper trail for protection
They reduce your boss's anxiety and build trust
They guarantee a positive performance review
